# Tests and validation {#sec-ch13}

This chapter explains how kintera's tests are organised, how to run them, what a run at the code pin gives on a CPU
build and on a CUDA build, which code paths the suite exercises on one device only, and what the validation cases
compare against. Appendix C (@sec-appc) lists every `ctest` entry; this chapter explains how those entries come to
exist and how to read their results.

TODO (structure draft): a dependency-map figure of the six schemes (the suite layout feeds the measured results and
the device coverage; the comparison cases and the examples sit beside the suite).

| scheme | option | default | main test |
|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch13-suite | `ctest`, `pytest` | all registered | all |
| @sec-ch13-results | build type, devices | CPU build | all |
| @sec-ch13-device-coverage | device of the inputs | CPU | `test_cuda_workspace.py` |
| @sec-ch13-kinetics-base | external paths for the Titan cases | in-tree cases run | `test_kinetics_base.py` |
| @sec-ch13-vulcan | none | not runnable from the repository | scoped out |
| @sec-ch13-examples | none | not registered | run by hand: 7 of 9 |
